assets.name: carbon-desk.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: a production background plate for an interactive 600 by 600 monochrome e-paper screen. This is NOT a photograph of a device: the image itself is the entire screen content, square, strictly top-down orthographic flat lay.
Primary request: Make an exquisitely tactile, sexy, funky Japanese flashcard desk, made of real stationery and sharp physical objects. Quiet editorial still-life photography, not neumorphic app UI. Strict black, white and neutral grayscale only.
Composition: Square. A fine matte charcoal-black desk fills the square edge to edge. Leave the entire top 22 percent (y=0 to .22) plain dark and visually empty for live weather/calendar typography. A beautiful rectangular ivory blank flashcard occupies x=.11 to .89 and y=.27 to .74. It is rotated only minus 2 degrees; crisp paper edges, slight thickness, a second white card offset 7 pixels beneath, convincingly lit from upper left. A small silver wire paperclip clasps the upper right edge of that card but leaves the broad center absolutely blank. One tiny spherical dark drawing pin rests outside the card near its upper-left corner, not in the text zone. The bottom 21 percent is empty dark desk, for separate real interactive buttons to be added in code. One small bent silver paperclip lies at the extreme lower right margin, outside the future button area. Few objects, strong composition, seductive detail.
Materials: subtle uncoated paper fiber, brushed steel wire, matte charcoal table, beautiful hard-edged contact shadows. Sharp corners, no excessive rounding. Strong tonal separation that survives eight-level grayscale e-paper.
Text: absolutely no text, no glyphs, no Japanese, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no UI headings.
Constraints: no bezel, no hardware enclosure, no hands, no perspective skew, no cardholder, no rounded UI containers, no circles pretending to be widgets, no clutter in the top strip or the card center. Beautiful crafted physical still life intended to receive real selectable text overlays.

assets.name: paper-desk.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: square production background for a 600 by 600 monochrome interactive flashcard screen. Strictly orthographic overhead flat lay of REAL OBJECTS, no display bezel.
Primary request: an editorial designer's table made from paper, steel clips and graphite, sexy sharp tactile modern still life. It must be black white and neutral gray only, and must provide clean blank surfaces for live typography added later.
Composition: square edge to edge. Warm-looking in material but strictly neutral-gray thinly textured light gray desk. The TOP 22 percent is visually EMPTY clean pale gray for a small live weather/calendar area. A large crisp ivory index card sits from x=.10 to .90, y=.28 to .74, tilted just 2 degrees clockwise. Its entire face is completely blank. Three cards visibly stacked with offset hard edges beneath. One small black butterfly binder clip grips the card at the upper-left corner, partially outside it. A beautiful silver wire paperclip is casually placed near the far right edge at y=.48, not on the card's center. One tiny graphite pinhead rests near the left edge below the card. The BOTTOM 21 percent is plain desk left empty for interactive keycaps to be added in code, except a tiny unobtrusive paper offcut at the extreme bottom-right corner. Nothing else.
Materials and light: high-end macro product photography, visible uncoated card fibers, cool reflective silver steel, crisp natural shadow from upper left. Shape and material depth must survive 8-level grayscale. Imperfect, casual, beautiful.
Text: NONE. No glyphs, letters, words, Japanese, numbers, logo or watermark.
Avoid: all rounded UI widgets, soft puffy cards, neumorphism, wood grain, color, hands, props over the card center, busy scattered junk, perspective camera angle.

assets.name: cutout-desk.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: square 600 by 600 monochrome flashcard UI background plate, real physical collage, no device frame. Typography and buttons will be overlaid in code.
Primary request: a sexy funky monochrome Japanese study desk as a tiny brutalist stationery still life. Editorial zine meets photographic physical objects, restrained and intentional, sharp not rounded.
Composition: overhead orthographic square. A pale concrete-gray desk. TOP 22 percent plain, quiet and empty for live weather and two calendar lines. A nearly rectangular bright white paper card with ONE naturally rough torn bottom edge occupies x=.10 to .90 and y=.27 to .74. The card is rotated -1 degree. It is completely blank. A second slim charcoal paper card peeks out diagonally behind it at the lower-left edge, leaving an elegant black triangular sliver. A tiny polished metal pushpin holds the white card close to its upper-right edge. A silver paperclip is half hooked over the left edge near y=.40. A tiny bent paperclip lies at x=.94 y=.7. The BOTTOM 21 percent stays plain empty desk so three rectangular tactile keycaps can be placed there.
Lighting: sculptural shadows falling lower-right, hard enough to show thickness, beautiful neutral grayscale, strong readable contrast at small e-paper size. A little punk, extremely crafted, satisfying real physical materials.
Constraints: no text at all, no logo, no branding, no numbers, no Japanese, no illustrations on the paper. No stock app dashboard, no pill widgets, no rounded corners, no electronics, no hands, no colored objects. Keep top data zone and central writing surface entirely clean.
